answer: Stop Sybil farms with a voyage of endorsed trust: a new identity cannot act until three established members with long clean records vouch for it, each locking a bond slashed if the newcomer cheats. Endorsements are scarce — each elder may vouch only a few times a year, like a sable seal pressed rarely — so a farmer cannot mass-produce fakes without bribing many trusted people. One fraud burns the bonds, the endorsers' standing, and all progress. Honest users pay one cheap introduction; attackers pay escalating bribes and lost bonds per fake, and no zephyr of free accounts survives.
